content.short: Travessia Credit brings private credit exposure onchain as a tokenized real-world asset.
content.description: Travessia Credit tokenizes private credit exposure on Monad, giving on-chain capital access to lending returns generated outside crypto markets. Private credit is among the more common real-world assets brought on-chain, though it carries the usual caveat that the underlying loans remain as opaque as they are off-chain.
content.meta: Private credit returns generated outside crypto, tokenized on Monad.
